windows.heading: PARLIAMENT OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA INLAND REVENUE (AME

entities.band_label: Tax rate for Employees’ Trust Funds, Provident, Pension or Gratuity Funds and Termination Funds
entities.applies_to: Employees’ Trust Fund, an approved provident or pension fund, or an approved termination fund
entities.act_name: Inland Revenue Amendment Act No. 14 of 2023
entities.quote: The taxable income of the Employees’ Trust Fund, an approved provident or pension fund, or an approved termination fund for a year of assessment commencing on or prior to April 1, 2022 and for the first six months period of the year of assessment commencing on April 1, 2023 shall be taxed at the rate of 14%.
entities.pass2_note: The candidate quote appears verbatim in the source text.

entities.band_label: Tax rate for Employees’ Trust Funds, Provident, Pension or Gratuity Funds and Termination Funds
entities.applies_to: Employees’ Trust Fund, an approved provident or pension fund, or an approved termination fund
entities.act_name: Inland Revenue Amendment Act No. 14 of 2023
entities.quote: Subject to subparagraphs (3) and (4), the taxable income of the Employees’ Trust Fund, an approved provident or pension fund or an approved termination fund for the second six months period of the year of assessment commencing on April 1, 2023 and for each year of assessment commencing on or after April 1, 2024, shall be taxed at the rate of 14%.
entities.pass2_note: The candidate quote appears verbatim in the source text, ignoring whitespace differences.

entities.band_label: Tax rate for Employees’ Trust Funds, Provident, Pension or Gratuity Funds and Termination Funds
entities.applies_to: Employees’ Trust Fund, an approved provident or pension fund, or an approved termination fund
entities.act_name: Inland Revenue Amendment Act No. 14 of 2023
entities.quote: Such part of the gains and profits received or derived by the Employees’ Trust Fund, an approved provident or pension fund or an approved termination fund from treasury bonds, for the second six months period of the year of assessment commencing on April 1, 2023 and for each year of assessment commencing on or after April 1, 2024, shall be taxed at the rate of 30%.
entities.pass2_note: The candidate quote appears verbatim in the source text.

entities.band_label: Tax rate for Employees’ Trust Funds, Provident, Pension or Gratuity Funds and Termination Funds
entities.applies_to: Employees’ Trust Fund, an approved provident or pension fund, or an approved termination fund
entities.act_name: Inland Revenue Amendment Act No. 14 of 2023
entities.quote: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the provisions of subparagraph (3), if the Employees’ Trust Fund, an approved provident or pension fund or an approved termination fund has invested in eligible bonds, and the Registrar of the Public Debt Department of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka confirms that any such fund has effectively participated in the process of domestic debt optimization approved by the Parliament by Resolution dated July 1, 2023, such part of the gains and profits received or derived by such funds from the treasury bonds, for the second six months period of the year of assessment commencing on April 1, 2023 and for each year of assessment commencing on or after April 1, 2024 shall be taxed at the rate of 14%.
